recipes.name: Grandpa’s Tomato Gravy
ingredients_raw: 8 slices bacon, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
1 teaspoon white sugar, or more to taste
0.5 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste

steps.text: Cook bacon in a Dutch oven over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until fat starts to render, about 2 minutes. Add onion; cook and stir until onion softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in diced tomatoes and tomato sauce; season with sugar and black pepper. Simmer until sauce is reduced by at least one-fourth and up to one-third, 30 to 45 minutes. Stir in butter just before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Grandpa’s Tomato Gravy
raw_recipe.description: Grandpa’s simple tomato gravy recipe can be served over rice, pasta, biscuits, or grits. But it is really a sauce (because it does not contain flour).

review.reviewBody: This is a very good recipe! I had all I could do to keep my spoon out of it while it was cooking. I thought the texture was very smooth on the tongue. M”Lady gave it a definite large 5 stars, and I concur wholeheartedly. I’m thinking of adding some oregano and garlic, and trying it as a spaghetti sauce. It’s definitely a recipe to keep.
Yum! Tried this over pasta (halved the recipe and used less onion) and it was great! Thanks!

Thank you for posting this, Bud. My father in law actually made this for me when my husband and I started dating (and he made it for my husband growing up) and I didn't ask him how he made it before he passed. My husband asks about this quite often but I didn't know how to make it. This is EXACTLY how he made it, only he added a little "green" spice I didn't catch. I did add a half tsp. each of basil and oregano and that was it exactly. I only had a small taste but my husband and kids ate almost all of it over parmesan noodles. You made our day. And sometimes, it's really the simplest things that get you every time. Thank you.

There's something really timeless about tomato gravy which is not the same thing as marinara sauce. The flavors meld together with the long simmer and it's wonderful. I personally like to use the diced fire roasted tomatoes in this sauce. Wonderful and simple. Thanks Bud!

This is awesome stuff. My children (who are not picky eaters) loved it and so did I. We added mushrooms for fun since I was out of onions. I also used fresh tomatoes for the diced tomatoes and serve it over tinkyada rotini noodles.
This is a great recipe and even better the next day! I particularly liked it with meatballs served with rice.

This is part of Hoppin John.
Put rice in a bowl, add tomato gravy and top with black eye peas. Eat with a hunk of cornbread and it's a great southern dish with onions. Yummmmy
Two extra tasty ingredients to add are worchestire sauce and red wine

Great recipe! Easy to make and served over meatloaf. For health reasons, left out the bacon, and it was still great. A healthy alternative to ketchup, and goes well over potatoes too! Will definitely make again.

I halved it & edited. Bottom line: For me, I'd like a fresh slice of tomato on a biscuit with/without bacon & onion rather than this; buttttt, until now, I've never heard of or made tomato gravy so maybe it's one of those things ya have to grow up on? I'm glad I tried it though! Thanks for sharing it.

We have tried for 8 years, since my mother-in law died, to make her meatloaf red gravy. This is the closest we have ever come! Thank you Bud for sharing! They only thing we did different was add the meatloaf juice.
I love the recipe, the only thing was I took out the bacon to use in my salad. It was simple and easy to make.
I made an account just to tell you how much I loved it! Simple to make and tastes delicious! ^~^
